notes.title: October 28th "Charcoal Extinguished" v0.5.0.0 major version update announcement
notes.content:
Dear players and friends,

update and upgrade "Charcoal Extinguishing" to version 0.5.0.0 at 12:00 noon on October 28. In this update, we actively responded to the feedback from the majority of players, solved many bugs and gameplay difficulties in the game, and on the basis of retaining the storyline of Chinese folk elements, we have comprehensively optimized the exploration experience of the large world map . At the same time, it also includes many new features . We hope to welcome everyone to experience it with a brand new look.

[v0.5.0.0 version update content]

1、The demo version was released at the same time
We have separately produced a trial experience package with the same gameplay as the full game. In the trial package, you can experience the main storyline of "Qiao Family Clinic", "Safflower Field" and "Mysterious Winery". The estimated gaming experience time will be more than 3 hours.

2、New terrain and large world map
The new terrain and landforms are randomly generated by the program, with new mountains and rivers, which can better show the randomness of the terrain and the realism of the landform changes compared with previous versions. At the same time, new generation rules and program algorithms are used to avoid BUG problems caused by the fusion of different terrains.

3、Strengthen the new user guidance
A new guide task has been added at the beginning of the game to help you get started quickly. With the help and prompts based on the system, you can understand the gameplay more quickly.

4、Main story guide
The game has removed the design of collecting map fragments and exploring plot points on your own. Now, as the main storyline progresses, you can open the mini-map to view the next plot guide, simplifying the boring experience of excessive running around.

5、Planting system
Obtain plant seeds by collecting and gathering plants in the big world, plant them in specific planting racks for cultivation, and wait for the plants to grow before harvesting.

6、Game difficulty selection
We provide 2 different game modes for players to set and switch at any time.
1）[Story Mode] A mode designed for new players, story fans, architects, etc. who want a more casual experience
2）[Survival Mode] A game mode designed for players who want to challenge higher difficulty and feel the real pressure of survival.

7、New teleportation array system
In order to avoid boring and repetitive map-running experience, we have remade the teleportation array function in the game. The teleportation array drawings can be unlocked in the early plot, and the teleportation location can be freely set, which effectively reduces the time cost of players on the road in the big world.

8、Optimize drawing unlocking rules
Game prop production is the core module of SOC type games. In order to prevent players from missing out on key production props and being unable to continue the game, after this update, you can unlock the production drawings of the corresponding level by upgrading the workbench, without having to search for them yourself. (Some plot prop drawings will be unlocked in the main scene or after killing the BOSS)

9、Wild exploration and monster refresh
Compared with the wilderness and deserted village design in the previous version, after this update, players can experience about 36 different types of gameplay structures at once. Each scene will refresh various ghosts and monsters regularly, eliminating the trouble of not being able to find monsters.

10、New weather system
We have comprehensively improved the performance of the day and night visual effects in the game. Now you can more intuitively feel the difference between day and night in Yinxu. At the same time, we have also manually adjusted the lighting effects of each location to make the overall atmosphere of the game more contrasting.

11、Global action optimization
We are continuously optimizing the actions of characters and monsters to make their behaviors more natural.

12、Other content
1）Production facilities can be operated in batches. Stoves, wine barrels, silkworm beds, kilns and other production facilities now support batch production of props.
2）Clarify the area display in the world. Now you can more clearly get your own area location on the map and minimap.
3）Clarify the way to obtain props. Now you can get the acquisition information and drop location of the prop by checking the text description of the prop.
4）The casserole props required in the cooking process have been deleted, and now you can cook food directly.
5）Enhanced the folk feeling within the game.
6）Adjusted the submission props of the three braziers outside the ancient gate tower to make the game plot smoother.


[ FAQ for v0.5.0.0]

Q1When 	will the new version of "Charcoal Extinguished" be updated? Can I continue playing the game with the previous saves after the update?
The new version will be officially updated at 12:00 on October 28, 2024. Due to large-scale adjustments to the terrain, structure, and gameplay in the new version, the previous version archives cannot be used in the current version. If some players still want to use the previous archives to play the game, they can select the previous version in the game properties. For specific operation methods, please contact the QQ group administrator.

Q2 	Where can I download the game demo? Can the demo save file be used in the official version?
You can search for "Tank Extinguish" in Steam and enter the game store page to download the trial version of "Tank Extinguish" for free.
The trial version and the official version are two separate packages. Due to the rules of Steam cloud archive settings, the archives of the two cannot be shared and used with each other.

Q3What 	are the main updates in the new version? What bugs are fixed? What problems are solved?
For the main update content of the new version of "Charcoal Extinguished", please refer to the update content in this announcement. In addition to the main updates, we have also adjusted many detailed settings in the game, which can be experienced in the new version of the game.
Regarding the bugs fixed and the problems solved, we have solved three major issues:
1）	Make the game easier, reduce unnecessary exploration time during the map running process, and make the game more friendly.
2）	Clarify the goals of the game. Through the guidance of the new version, you can better establish the goals of the game, allowing players to quickly understand the gameplay and feel the core fun.
3）	Fixed blocking issues that occurred in previous versions, such as characters being stuck on incorrect terrain and some resources not being generated.

notes.title: Game Skills & Operation Tips
notes.content:
[h2]Game Controls[/h2]
1. [Key] If you find that item descriptions are missing in the game, try pressing the Y key to activate tooltips.
2. [Key] The X key allows you to switch between walking and jogging.
3. [Inventory] Tools or materials can be placed in slots 1 to 8 for easy switching.
4. [Logging] The F key is for heavy attacks, which can also be used to significantly increase logging efficiency.
5. [Interaction] Picking up and interacting in the game is done using the E key.
6. [Interaction] If the game requires multiple selections, use the mouse wheel to select and press the E key to confirm.

[h2]1.Survival Tips[/h2]
1. [Sneaking] Press the C key to crouch and move forward, which can reduce the chance of being detected by ghosts.
2. [Multiplayer] Playing in multiplayer can significantly reduce the game's difficulty and also enhance the fun of playing together.
3. [Logging] Using an axe to chop trees will split the tree into whole trunks and stumps, which can be further chopped to obtain wood and other materials.
4. [Death Penalty] Upon death, items in your backpack will drop at the location of death, and skill proficiency may randomly decrease.
5. [Food] Place a grill over a fire to roast raw food.
6. [Entering the Wilderness] After entering the game, consider first finding scattered supplies and press T to craft a torch for lighting, a wooden sword for defense, and a stone axe for logging.
7. [Ghost Repelling Techniques] If you encounter a door ghost, try splashing it with black dog's blood.
8. [Combat Tips] When facing a BOSS, try using ranged weapons to gradually wear it down.
9. [Proficiency] Any action performed by the character can improve proficiency in that action, such as logging, jumping, or attacking with a wooden sword.
10. [Crafting Items] There are two ways to craft items in the game: crafting by hand for basic tools; crafting at a workbench for tools and weapons.
11. [Repair and Upgrade] Weapons, equipment, and tools can be repaired and upgraded at their respective workbenches.
12. [Crafting Items] There are three types of workbenches in the game: Tool Bench, Weapon Bench, and Tailoring Bench.
13. [Cooking Tips] Placing a grill on a campfire allows for basic food grilling; placing a pot on a stove allows for cooking more advanced dishes.
14. [Blueprint Unlocking] Collecting game supplies and meeting the requirements of a blueprint will automatically unlock it.
15. [Blueprint Unlocking] Some crafting blueprints require advancing the main storyline to obtain.
16. [Item Types] Items in the game can be broadly categorized into materials, food ingredients, processed goods, and building materials.
17. [Survival Tips] Eating food can increase health and stamina, some foods can be eaten raw, others need to be cooked to increase a large amount of health and stamina.
18. [Survival Tips] We recommend keeping three different food effects active at all times, as their effects will stack and improve survival ability.
19. [Survival Tips] To enhance survivability, we recommend prioritizing the upgrade of weapons and armor.

[h2]2.Adventure Tips[/h2]
1. [Unexpected Discoveries] Try using pickaxe-type tools to destroy large objects like water barrels or carts to obtain corresponding material fragments.
2. [Logging Tips] Axe tools come in varieties such as stone axes, iron axes, and copper axes; the stronger the axe, the more types of trees it can chop.
3. [Map Marking] Map markers can be used as navigational aids, use them wisely to avoid getting lost in the willow groves.
4. [Plot Clues] The main storyline in the game is distributed in the form of clue fragments across the world, which need to be found and analyzed to further advance the storyline.
5. [Unknown Items] If you find unknown items hanging from trees, try using a slingshot to knock them down, or simply chop down the tree.
6. [Beginner] If you find plot clues, also try to interpret and reason them out, which will give you the next target.
7. [Plot Clues] After obtaining plot clues, you can press the J key to open the notebook; some clues allow you to turn pages by pressing the A/D keys.
8. [Beginner] Defeated BOSSes can be challenged again.

[h2]3.Building Tips[/h2]
1. [Building Guide] Use foundations to level the ground, erect walls, and cover with a roof to form a complete house.
2. [Building Guide] When you have a tool hammer in your backpack, press the R key to quickly enter building mode.
3. [Building Guide] When starting to build, prioritize placing a Shigangdang to create a buildable area.
4. [Building Guide] Steps to become a building master: matchbox - Huizhou house - courtyard - village
5. [Building Guide] Small houses can have freely constructed roofs, while larger houses need columns and beams to support expansive roofs.
6. [Building Guide] Repairing weapons, equipment, tools, and fixing damaged buildings does not require any materials.
7. [Building Guide] If the building is too tall, you can place "ladder" items appropriately so that characters can reach higher positions.
[h2]4.Friendly Tips[/h2]
1. [Storage Advice] You can craft and place a large number of wooden boxes in shelters to store items from your backpack.
2. [Friendly Tips] We advise not to randomly discard resources and items on the ground; items will disappear after leaving a certain range!

notes.title: AsHes launches Early Access globally today!
notes.content:
“Rising Smokes, Extinguished AsHes” Released Today—The Official Start of Chinese Folklore Survival Adventure!
Dear gaming friends, we greatly appreciate your support and attention to our game! On June 24, the Chinese folklore survival adventure game 'Extinguished Ashes' officially released its Early Access version. We sincerely invite you to explore this world with us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2455040

'Extinguished Ashes' is an open-world survival adventure game themed on Chinese folklore, featuring survival, crafting, building, and multiplayer online as its core gameplay (SurvivalCraft). Based on stories created from Chinese folklore, it offers a unique experience of the Chinese underworld during your exploration and discovery within the game. In the Early Access version, we bring you a plethora of game content, including the complete SurvivalCraft core gameplay. This includes exploring the vast underworld, collecting and unlocking crafting blueprints, building your own home, and experiencing thrilling instance-based gameplay. The story exploration path will also present you with a total of 26 main plot levels, collecting story clues to gradually unveil the truth behind what happened in Yaoshan and decipher the stories behind the characters. We estimate that a single round of gameplay experience will last over 100 hours. During the Early Access period, we will continue to enhance the gaming experience of the Chinese folklore SurvivalCraft, and we also look forward to receiving feedback and suggestions from our players."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950084/2ffbfb0bbb35eb13c5c01942b8d419a074c256c6.png[/img]

[h2]Regarding the Early Access version, information players need to know:[/h2]

[h3]1. Why adopt the Early Access model?[/h3]
To create a richer open world based on Chinese folklore and a more exploratory game mode, we believe it is crucial to adjust and update the game based on actual player feedback. 
"AsHes" is a Survivalcraft game themed around Chinese folklore, focusing on survival exploration and crafting as its core gameplay. It integrates a carefully designed main storyline into this open world. This innovative game mode aims to provide players with a unique experience different from previous open-world survival games. To gather more extensive player feedback and make this exploratory experience more interesting, player assistance is indispensable. Therefore, we decided to release the game in an Early Access format and sincerely look forward to players' feedback.

[h3]2. How different will the planned full version be from the Early Access version?[/h3]
Our core goal is to further enhance the gameplay experience of the Chinese folklore Survivalcraft game, including more enjoyable exploration gameplay, deeper survival experiences, richer folklore settings, and elements, making the Yaoshan world more realistic. Additionally, we will consider introducing new gameplay and systems based on player feedback.

[h3]3. What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/h3]
In the current version of the game, the core gameplay based on Survivalcraft games is already mature, offering high playability and enjoyment. In the current version, players can experience 26 chapters of story missions across three main chapters, over 160 types of building components, more than 150 crafting recipes, over 70 weapons and equipment, as well as many folklore records and story bosses unique to Chinese folklore.
